expert.missing_public_payload_behavior: explicit fallback weights; no hidden future or simulator state fields are read
expert.normalization_rule: group eligible actions by public category; apply public-state category multipliers; normalize positive category weights; then sample within the chosen category by public action score

rule_groups.card_rewards: prefer early damage, draw, energy, and scaling; prefer defense when visible HP is low; keep skips and weak cards reachable
rule_groups.events: conservative label-based priors avoid visible damage/curse costs when low HP while keeping legal branches reachable
rule_groups.fallback: unknown or missing public payloads use positive fallback weights rather than deterministic first-action behavior
rule_groups.resources: take relics/treasure by default; keep skips, potion discards, and keys as low-probability legal alternatives
rule_groups.rest_sites: prefer upgrades by default, but boost rest when current HP is low
rule_groups.route_choices: use action labels and public resources as route proxies; prefer elites with healthy HP or potions, prefer rests/shops when low
rule_groups.shops: prefer removals, high-impact relic/cards, useful potions with empty slots, and retain some gold by keeping skip reachable

information_regime.battle: same native Battle Search-v2@400 in every arm and continuation suffix
information_regime.candidate_mapping: source-ordered projection candidate occurrence i maps only to live legal action i; exact counts and semantic identities are checked before selection
information_regime.expert: external comparison arm only; never in training or branch suffixes
information_regime.model_inputs: semantic feature values and visibility tags only; no source names, candidate bindings, candidate indices, action ids, labels, bits, native slot indices, or source metadata
information_regime.multi_action_states: one shared action-conditioned categorical policy across all nonbattle screen types

public_history_runtime.existing_history_validation: no recursive prior-entry revalidation per transition
public_history_runtime.history_consumer_audit: ExpertNonCombatDriver reads current location, visible boss and persistent resources; it does not read history; MAP/REWARDS keep exact history conservatively
public_history_runtime.intermediate_history: full detached history only on MAP/REWARDS decision contexts; empty intermediate/post contexts otherwise
public_history_runtime.new_entry_validation: pinned sanitizer and schema/version/index check once before append
public_history_runtime.projection_cache: one consecutive post-transition to next-decision reuse keyed by exact adapter and snapshot object identity; disabled when a before-decision transform is installed
public_history_runtime.semantics: native action selection, candidate order, Search-v2@400, Expert seeds, checkpoint restores and terminal utility unchanged
public_history_runtime.terminal_history: full detached history materialized once after each controlled run
